name: Wilcox Woodworks, Inc.
old_description: Wilcox Woodworks specializes in the design and manufacture of custom furniture, cabinets and millwork. We have the imagination, initiative and readiness to perform the most challenging projects. With competitive pricing, we deliver projects on time, on budget and with meticulous attention to the details. It is our commitment to deliver complete customer satisfaction.
about:
Wilcox Woodworks, Inc. operates from Manassas, Virginia, as a full-service architectural millwork provider. The company designs, fabricates, and installs custom woodwork for commercial and government projects.

Its capabilities span design, fabrication, and installation of panel systems, trim, doors, cabinets, and siding using wood, plastics, plastic laminate, metals, glass, and stone. The firm produces a STANDARD Line of conference-room and AV-conferencing furniture, including four models of an articulating conference table, as well as lecterns, credenzas, and custom tables in any commercially available wood species. It also builds outdoor structures such as pergolas, arbors, gazebos, gates, and benches from Spanish cedar and western redwood, and supplies retail and restaurant fixtures including cashwraps, display cases, and complete interior packages.

Wilcox Woodworks serves AV integrators and government agencies, a relationship spanning over twenty years, along with retail, restaurant, and commercial construction clients needing architectural millwork for lobbies, elevators, and tenant build-outs.

The company emphasizes quality of design, material, and workmanship, committing to on-schedule, on-budget delivery and a streamlined ordering experience through its STANDARD Line program.
